    let inSolid = 0, under = 0, blocked = 0, n = 0, firstBad = -1;
    let crowd = 0, crowdBad = 0, outF = 0, fn = 0, crowdMax = 0, firstCrowd = -1, lastFrameT = -1, away = 0, faceN = 0;
    const faceShot = sh.who && sh.ctx.subj && ["cu", "ecu", "medium", "push"].includes(sh.kind), faceLim = sh.kind === "cu" || sh.kind === "ecu" ? 0.45 : 0.42;
    for (let t = sh.t0 + 0.05; t < Math.min(sh.t1, P.duration) - 0.02; t += 1 / fps) {
      n++; camFrames++;
      const c = P.cam(t);
      const g = pl.ground ? pl.ground(c.pos[0], c.pos[2]) : b ? b.nav.floor(c.pos[0], c.pos[2]) : pl.floor;
      if (c.pos[1] < g + 0.08) { under++; if (firstBad < 0) firstBad = t; }
      if ([...blockers, ...(pl.soft ?? []), ...(pl.swings ?? [])].some((x) => inside(c.pos, grow(x, 0.02)))) { inSolid++; if (firstBad < 0) firstBad = t; }
      // framing on screen, sampled every 0.25 s: near surfaces over the picture, the subject outside the frame
      if (t - lastFrameT >= 0.25) {
        lastFrameT = t; fn++;
        if (sh.kind !== "pov" && sh.kind !== "ecu") {
          const focus = c.focus ?? Math.hypot(c.target[0] - c.pos[0], c.target[1] - c.pos[1], c.target[2] - c.pos[2]);
          const cov = nearCover(pl, c.pos, c.target, c.fov, P.aspect, focus);
          crowdMax = Math.max(crowdMax, cov);
          if (cov > 0.3) { crowd++; if (firstCrowd < 0) firstCrowd = t; }
          if (cov > 0.45) crowdBad++;
        }
        // a face shot shows the face: the lens within ~63° (close-up) / 65° (medium) of where the person looks
        if (faceShot) {
          const e = sh.ctx.subj!.eye(t).dir, h = sh.ctx.subj!.head(t), vx = c.pos[0] - h[0], vz = c.pos[2] - h[2];
          faceN++;
          if ((e[0] * vx + e[2] * vz) / ((Math.hypot(e[0], e[2]) * Math.hypot(vx, vz)) || 1) < faceLim) away++;
        }
        // only framings that are about the person (inserts frame the hands, reveals swing to the thing, OTS / long look past them)
        if (sh.who && ["wide", "mediumWide", "medium", "cu", "push", "pull", "profile", "low", "high", "lead", "track", "orbit", "twoShot"].includes(sh.kind)) {
          const p = P.poseOf(sh.who, t);
          if (p) {
            const pj = frameOf(c.pos, c.target, c.fov, P.aspect).project([p.x, p.y + 1.45 + p.hipY, p.z]);
            if (pj.z <= 0 || Math.abs(pj.x) > 0.98 || Math.abs(pj.y) > 0.98) outF++;
          }
        }
      }
      if (sh.who && sh.kind !== "pov") {
        const p = P.poseOf(sh.who, t);
        if (p) {
          const head: V3 = [p.x, p.y + 1.45 + p.hipY, p.z];
          // the box the subject stands in / sits on never counts as a blocker
          const hit = named.find((x) => !inside(head, grow(x.box, 0.3)) && !inside([p.x, p.y + 0.5 + p.hipY, p.z], grow(x.box, 0.2)) && crosses(c.pos, head, x.box));
          if (hit) { blocked++; why.set(hit.id, (why.get(hit.id) ?? 0) + 1); }
        }
      }
    }
    const label = `shot ${si + 1} (${sh.kind}${sh.who ? " " + sh.who : ""}, ${sh.t0.toFixed(1)}–${sh.t1.toFixed(1)} s)`;
    if (inSolid > 0) add("camera-in-solid", inSolid / Math.max(1, n) > 0.1 ? "error" : "warn", `${label}: lens inside an object / wall / foliage on ${inSolid}/${n} samples`, firstBad);
    if (under > 0) add("camera-underground", "error", `${label}: lens below the ground on ${under}/${n} samples`, firstBad);
    if (fn && crowd / fn > 0.3) add("camera-crowded", crowdBad / fn > 0.4 ? "error" : "warn", `${label}: a surface right at the lens covers up to ${Math.round(100 * crowdMax)}% of the picture on ${Math.round((100 * crowd) / fn)}% of the shot (a wall / furniture too close) — move the people / force another shot or side`, firstCrowd);
    if (fn && outF / fn > 0.25) add("subject-out-of-frame", outF / fn > 0.6 ? "error" : "warn", `${label}: ${sh.who}'s head is outside the ${P.format} frame on ${Math.round((100 * outF) / fn)}% of the shot`, sh.t0);
    if (faceN && away / faceN > 0.5) add("face-turned-away", away / faceN > 0.7 && (sh.kind === "cu" || sh.kind === "ecu") ? "error" : "warn", `${label}: ${sh.who}'s face is turned away from the camera on ${Math.round((100 * away) / faceN)}% of the shot (only the side / back of the head shows) — they face a wall, window or thing too close for a camera in front: give the mark ≥ 1.5 m in front of the face, turn them to the room, or show what they look at over the shoulder (ots)`, sh.t0);
    if (n && blocked / n > 0.4) add("subject-hidden", blocked / n > 0.75 ? "error" : "warn", `${label}: ${sh.who} hidden behind ${[...why.entries()].sort((x, y) => y[1] - x[1]).slice(0, 2).map(([k]) => (k.startsWith("a ") ? k : `"${k}"`)).join(" / ")} on ${Math.round((100 * blocked) / n)}% of the shot`, sh.t0);
  });
  stats.cameraSamples = camFrames;
  stats.shots = P.shots.length;

  // ── continuity across scene cuts ─────────────────────────────────────────
  for (let k = 1; k < P.scenes.length; k++) {
    const A = P.scenes[k - 1], B = P.scenes[k];
    if (A.place.id !== B.place.id || B.cut !== "cut") continue;
    for (const who of B.cast) {
      if (!A.cast.includes(who)) continue;
      const pa = P.poseOf(who, B.t0 - 0.05), pb = P.poseOf(who, B.t0 + 0.05);
      if (!pa || !pb) continue;
      const jump = Math.hypot(pa.x - pb.x, pa.z - pb.z);
      if (jump > 0.12 && jump < 1.2) add("jump-cut", "warn", `scene ${k + 1} at ${B.t0.toFixed(1)} s: ${who} jumps ${jump.toFixed(2)} m across a hard cut in the same place (reads as a glitch — start the scene where the last one ended, or move further)`, B.t0);
      const ha = pa.hold?.kind, hb = pb.hold?.kind;
      if (ha !== hb && (ha === "lantern" || ha === "flashlight" || hb === "lantern" || hb === "flashlight")) add("prop-continuity", "warn", `scene ${k + 1}: ${who}'s ${ha ?? hb} ${ha ? "vanishes" : "appears"} across the cut`, B.t0);
    }
  }

  return { errors: out.filter((x) => x.level === "error"), warnings: out.filter((x) => x.level === "warn"), stats };
}

==== 38360 project/src/director/shots.ts
// Camera library. Every shot type is a function (context, film time) → Cam, computed from the people's
// performance and the place (POIs, establish hint, camera-safe box). Hand-held drift scales with the
// mood; positions are clamped legal (inside the place, out of walls); depth of field focuses on the
// shot's subject automatically.
// Portrait (9:16) has its own framings — not a crop of the landscape ones: subjects stay centred, eyes on
// the upper third, the frame is sized by how much of a person it should hold (face, waist-up, full figure),
// over-the-shoulder and two-shots are staggered in depth instead of side by side. Before a shot is used,
// every candidate framing is scored for: the lens pushed by walls, the view to the subject / target blocked,
// the subject outside the frame, and near surfaces (a wall at the lens) covering the picture.

import type { Cam } from "../cine/types.ts";
import { legalCam, type Place, type V3 } from "../worlds/types.ts";
import type { Mood, ShotName } from "./story.ts";

export type Subject = {
  /** root on the floor, smoothed over ±0.3 s (no walk bob) */
  pos: (t: number) => V3;
  head: (t: number) => V3;
  yaw: (t: number) => number;
  eye: (t: number) => { pos: V3; dir: V3 };
  hand: (t: number) => V3;
  /** where a raised phone is held */
  phone?: (t: number) => V3;
};

export type ShotCtx = {
  kind: ShotName;
  t0: number;
  t1: number;
  place: Place;
  subj?: Subject;
  subj2?: Subject;
  /** the thing looked at / shown */
  target?: (t: number) => V3;
  /** other people in the scene (they must not block the lens) */
  others?: (t: number) => V3[];
  side: 1 | -1;
  mood: Mood;
  fov?: number;
  seed: number;
  /** inserts: size (m) of the object handled — the camera stands back for big things */
  size?: number;
  /** frame width / height: 9 / 16 portrait (default), 16 / 9 landscape */
  aspect?: number;
  /** the person is using a phone (inserts look over the shoulder at its screen) */
  phone?: boolean;
};

const add = (a: V3, b: V3, k = 1): V3 => [a[0] + b[0] * k, a[1] + b[1] * k, a[2] + b[2] * k];
const sub = (a: V3, b: V3): V3 => [a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1], a[2] - b[2]];
const len = (a: V3) => Math.hypot(a[0], a[1], a[2]);
const mix = (a: V3, b: V3, k: number): V3 => [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * k];
const ease = (x: number) => { const k = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, x)); return k * k * (3 - 2 * k); };
const fwd = (yaw: number): V3 => [Math.sin(yaw), 0, Math.cos(yaw)];
const right = (yaw: number): V3 => [-Math.cos(yaw), 0, Math.sin(yaw)];
const n1 = (t: number, s: number) => Math.sin(t * 1.31 + s) * 0.6 + Math.sin(t * 2.17 + s * 1.7) * 0.3 + Math.sin(t * 3.71 + s * 2.3) * 0.1;

export const SHAKE: Record<Mood, number> = { mystery: 0.32, tense: 0.5, told: 0.2, memory: 0.15, calm: 0.12, reveal: 0.1, science: 0.04, warm: 0.1, cctv: 0 };
const SHAKE_K: Partial<Record<ShotName, number>> = { pov: 1.7, track: 1.3, lead: 1.2, establish: 0.25, drone: 0.2, map: 0.1, long: 0.9, insert: 0.6, cu: 0.8, ecu: 0.6, orbit: 0.3 };
const APERTURE: Partial<Record<ShotName, number>> = { cu: 0.012, ecu: 0.016, insert: 0.012, medium: 0.006, ots: 0.007, profile: 0.006, push: 0.006, lead: 0.004, track: 0.003, low: 0.004, twoShot: 0.004 };

type Rig = { pos: V3; target: V3; fov: number; focus?: V3; free?: boolean };
const isPortrait = (c: ShotCtx) => (c.aspect ?? 16 / 9) < 1;
/** a vertical FOV (deg) that holds `h` metres at distance `d` */
const fovFor = (h: number, d: number) => (2 * Math.atan2(h / 2, Math.max(0.05, d)) * 180) / Math.PI;

const rig = (c: ShotCtx, t: number, rot = 0, dk = 1, from?: V3): Rig => {
  // an insert of something out of reach is really a long-lens shot of it
  if (c.kind === "insert" && c.subj && c.target && len(sub(c.target(t), c.subj.head(t))) > 1.6) return rig({ ...c, kind: "long" }, t, rot, dk, from);
  // a far target the subject cannot see from here: shoot it from a clear vantage point instead
  if (from && c.target && (c.kind === "long" || c.kind === "ots" || c.kind === "reveal")) {
    const look = c.target(t), d = len(sub(look, from));
    return { pos: from, target: look, fov: c.fov ?? Math.max(4, Math.min(30, (2 * Math.atan2(d > 30 ? 6 : 1.6, d) * 180) / Math.PI)), focus: look, free: true };
  }
  const u = ease((t - c.t0) / Math.max(0.01, c.t1 - c.t0));
  const s = c.subj;
  const tgt = c.target ? c.target(t) : undefined;
  const E = c.place.establish;
  const P = isPortrait(c);
  if (!s) {
    // no person in shot: frame the target or the place (rot / dk: the candidate search swings and pulls in)
    const look = tgt ?? (c.place.pois[c.place.view] as V3) ?? E.center;
    switch (c.kind) {
      case "long": case "pov": case "ots": {
        // from the establishing ring, toward the target
        const a = E.yaw + c.side * 0.15 + rot;
        const from: V3 = add(E.center, [Math.sin(a) * E.radius * dk, E.height * 0.5, Math.cos(a) * E.radius * dk]);
        const d = len(sub(look, from));
        const f = Math.max(3, Math.min(30, (2 * Math.atan2(9, d) * 180) / Math.PI));
        return { pos: from, target: look, fov: c.fov ?? (P ? (d < 3 ? 56 : Math.min(46, f * 1.6)) : f) };
      }
      case "map": return { pos: add(E.center, [0.3 * E.radius * c.side, 1.7 * E.radius, 0.6 * E.radius]), target: E.center, fov: P ? 54 : 42 };
      case "orbit": {
        const a = E.yaw + c.side * (0.4 * u - 0.2) + rot, R = E.radius * 0.7 * dk;
        return { pos: add(look, [Math.sin(a) * R, E.height * 0.5, Math.cos(a) * R]), target: look, fov: P ? 48 : 36 };
      }
      default: {
        const a = E.yaw + c.side * 0.12 * u + rot, R = E.radius * dk * (c.kind === "drone" ? 1.6 - 0.25 * u : 1.1 - 0.12 * u), H = E.height * (c.kind === "drone" ? 2.0 - 0.4 * u : 1.25 - 0.3 * u);
        return { pos: add(E.center, [Math.sin(a) * R, H, Math.cos(a) * R]), target: mix(E.center, look, 0.25), fov: c.fov ?? (P ? 56 : 38) };
      }
    }
  }
  if (P) { const pr = portraitRig(c, t, u, s, tgt, rot, dk); if (pr) return pr; }
  const p = s.pos(t), h = s.head(t);
  // faces are framed from where the face looks, bodies from where the body faces
  const faceShot = c.kind === "cu" || c.kind === "ecu" || c.kind === "medium" || c.kind === "push";
  const ed = s.eye(t).dir, bodyYaw = s.yaw(t);
  const yaw = (faceShot && Math.hypot(ed[0], ed[2]) > 0.3 ? Math.atan2(ed[0], ed[2]) : bodyYaw) + rot, F = fwd(bodyYaw), Rt = right(bodyYaw);
  switch (c.kind) {
    case "establish": case "drone": {
      const a = E.yaw + c.side * 0.12 * u, R = E.radius * (c.kind === "drone" ? 1.6 - 0.25 * u : 1.05 - 0.15 * u), H = E.height * (c.kind === "drone" ? 2.0 - 0.4 * u : 1.2 - 0.35 * u);
      return { pos: add(E.center, [Math.sin(a) * R, H, Math.cos(a) * R]), target: mix(E.center, h, 0.45), fov: c.fov ?? 38 };
    }
    case "wide": {
      const a = yaw + c.side * 0.6, D = (c.place.kind === "interior" ? 3.4 : 6.5) * dk;
      const pos = add(add(p, fwd(a), D), [0, 1.55 + 0.1 * u, 0]);
      return { pos: add(pos, Rt, 0.25 * u * c.side), target: add(p, [0, 1.15, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? 42 };
    }
    case "mediumWide": {
      const a = yaw + c.side * 0.5;
      return { pos: add(add(p, fwd(a), (3.0 - 0.2 * u) * dk), [0, 1.35, 0]), target: add(p, [0, 0.95, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? (dk < 0.9 ? 44 : 36), focus: h };
    }
    case "medium": {
      const a = yaw + c.side * 0.42;
      return { pos: add(add(h, fwd(a), (1.75 - 0.15 * u) * dk), [0, -0.05, 0]), target: add(h, [0, -0.22, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? (dk < 0.9 ? 38 : 30), focus: h };
    }
    case "cu": {
      const a = yaw + c.side * 0.32;
      return { pos: add(add(h, fwd(a), 0.86 - 0.14 * u), [0, 0.0, 0]), target: add(h, [0, -0.02, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? 26, focus: h };
    }
    case "ecu": {
      const e = s.eye(t), a = yaw + c.side * 0.2;
      return { pos: add(add(e.pos, fwd(a), 0.42 - 0.06 * u), [0, 0.01, 0]), target: e.pos, fov: c.fov ?? 22, focus: e.pos };
    }
    case "ots": {
      const look = tgt ?? add(h, F, 6);
      const far = len(sub(look, h)) > 15;
      const back = sub(h, look);
      const bn = len(back) || 1;
      // a target well above the head (a bird in a tree, a window): drop to a low angle so the shoulder stays in frame
      const up = look[1] - h[1], low = up > 0.6;
      const pos = add(add(add(h, [back[0] / bn, 0, back[2] / bn], 1.25), Rt, 0.42 * c.side), [0, low ? 0.14 - Math.min(0.55, up * 0.25) : 0.14, 0]);
      return { pos, target: mix(look, h, far ? 0 : low ? 0.3 : 0.15), fov: c.fov ?? (far ? 30 : low ? 40 : 32), focus: look };
    }
    case "pov": {
      const e = s.eye(t), look = tgt ?? add(e.pos, e.dir, 8);
      const far = len(sub(look, e.pos)) > 15;
      return { pos: add(e.pos, F, 0.06), target: look, fov: c.fov ?? (far ? 24 : 40), focus: look };
    }
    case "long": {
      const look = tgt ?? add(h, F, 30);
      const win = c.place.window ? c.place.pois[c.place.window] : undefined;
      const through = c.place.kind === "interior" && !!win && len(sub(look, h)) > 15;
      // through a window: stand just outside the glass (a pane in front of a long lens reads as milk)
      const from = through ? add(win, sub(win, h), 0.12 / Math.max(0.3, len(sub(win, h)))) : add(add(h, Rt, 0.3 * c.side), [0, 0.05, 0]);
      const d = len(sub(look, from));
      const fov = c.fov ?? Math.max(2.5, Math.min(24, (2 * Math.atan2(d > 60 ? 9 : 3, d) * 180) / Math.PI));
      return { pos: from, target: look, fov: fov * (1 - 0.08 * u), focus: look, free: through };
    }
    case "track": {
      const pos = add(add(add(p, F, -2.3), Rt, 0.45 * c.side), [0, 1.62, 0]);
      return { pos, target: add(add(p, F, 3), [0, 1.3, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? 42, focus: h };
    }
    case "lead": {
      const pos = add(add(add(p, F, 2.6), Rt, 0.25 * c.side), [0, 1.5, 0]);
      return { pos, target: add(h, [0, -0.1, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? 34, focus: h };
    }
    case "profile": return { pos: add(add(p, right(yaw), 2.3 * c.side * dk), [0, 1.3, 0]), target: add(p, [0, 1.15, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? (dk < 0.9 ? 42 : 32), focus: h };
    case "low": return { pos: add(add(add(p, F, 1.9), Rt, 0.3 * c.side), [0, 0.42, 0]), target: add(h, [0, 0.1, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? 38, focus: h };
    case "high": return { pos: add(add(add(p, F, 1.4), Rt, 0.4 * c.side), [0, 3.3, 0]), target: add(p, [0, 0.7, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? 42, focus: h };
    case "insert": {
      // a phone in use and a thing the person looks at (not handles) are framed as in portrait: over the phone
      // hand's shoulder onto the screen; on the eye line, close to the thing's face
      if (c.phone) {
        const ph = s.phone?.(t) ?? s.hand(t);
        return { pos: add(add(add(h, F, -0.55), Rt, 0.45), [0, 0.18, 0]), target: ph, fov: c.fov ?? 26, focus: ph };
      }
      if (tgt && len(sub(tgt, s.hand(t))) > 0.45 && len(sub(tgt, h)) < 10) {
        const d = sub(tgt, h), dl = Math.hypot(d[0], d[2]) || 1, dn: V3 = [d[0] / dl, 0, d[2] / dl];
        const pos = add(add(tgt, dn, -0.75), [dn[2], 0, -dn[0]], 0.3 * c.side);
        return { pos: [pos[0], tgt[1] + 0.35, pos[2]], target: tgt, fov: c.fov ?? 30, focus: tgt };
      }
      // frame the hand AND what it handles: aim between them when the hand is near the target
      const hand = s.hand(t);
      const at = tgt && len(sub(tgt, h)) < 1.5 ? (len(sub(tgt, hand)) < 0.8 ? mix(tgt, hand, 0.45) : tgt) : hand;
      const fw = fwd(yaw);
      // from across the work, three-quarter on the working hand's side, looking down at hand + object;
      // the person is behind it, soft (the body can never cover the hand from here)
      const rt = right(yaw), hd = sub(hand, h), hs = Math.sign(hd[0] * rt[0] + hd[2] * rt[2]) || c.side;
      const sk = Math.min(2.6, Math.max(1, (c.size ?? 0) / 0.18));
      const pos = add(add(add(at, rt, 0.26 * hs * sk), fw, 0.34 * sk), [0, 0.4 * sk, 0]);
      return { pos, target: at, fov: c.fov ?? 38, focus: at };
    }
    case "orbit": {
      const look = tgt && len(sub(tgt, h)) < 6 ? mix(h, tgt, 0.5) : h;
      const a = yaw + c.side * (0.35 + 0.45 * u), R = 2.3;
      return { pos: add(look, [Math.sin(a) * R, 0.25, Math.cos(a) * R]), target: look, fov: c.fov ?? 34, focus: look };
    }
    case "push": {
      const a = yaw + c.side * 0.25;
      return { pos: add(add(h, fwd(a), 3.1 - 1.6 * u), [0, -0.05, 0]), target: add(h, [0, -0.08, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? 32, focus: h };
    }
    case "pull": {
      const a = yaw + c.side * 0.3;
      return { pos: add(add(h, fwd(a), 1.2 + 3.6 * u), [0, 0.1 + 0.8 * u, 0]), target: add(h, [0, -0.2 - 0.3 * u, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? 34, focus: h };
    }
    case "reveal": {
      const look = tgt ?? add(h, F, 10);
      const back = sub(h, look), bn = len(back) || 1;
      // from behind the shoulder, the head a third of the way in, then the view swings onto the thing
      const pos = add(add(add(h, [back[0] / bn, 0, back[2] / bn], 1.45), Rt, 0.62 * c.side), [0, 0.12, 0]);
      const k = ease((t - c.t0 - 0.4) / Math.max(0.5, (c.t1 - c.t0) * 0.6));
      return { pos, target: mix(mix(h, look, 0.3), look, k), fov: c.fov ?? 36, focus: k < 0.5 ? h : look };
    }
    case "map": return { pos: add(E.center, [0.3 * E.radius * c.side, 1.7 * E.radius, 0.6 * E.radius]), target: E.center, fov: 42 };
    case "twoShot": {
      const q = c.subj2 ? c.subj2.pos(t) : add(p, F, 1.5);
      const mid = mix(p, q, 0.5), d = sub(q, p), gap = Math.hypot(d[0], d[2]) || 1;
      const perp: V3 = [-d[2] / gap * c.side, 0, d[0] / gap * c.side];
      return { pos: add(add(mid, perp, Math.max(2.0, 1.15 * gap) * dk), [0, 1.45, 0]), target: add(mid, [0, 1.2, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? 40, focus: add(mid, [0, 1.5, 0]) };
    }
  }
  return { pos: add(h, F, 2), target: h, fov: 35 };
};

/** Portrait framings for a person (null = use the landscape one). Sizes are the frame height held at the
 *  subject (metres) — a 9:16 frame is 0.56 × as wide, so a face, a waist-up figure or a whole body fills it
 *  as it would on a phone; the aim point keeps the eyes on the upper third. */
/** Camera for a phone insert: behind / above one shoulder; k lifts and swings it out step by step. */
const phoneCam = (h: V3, F: V3, Rt: V3, k: number, side: number): V3 => add(add(add(h, F, -0.55 + 0.06 * k), Rt, (0.45 + 0.1 * k) * side), [0, 0.18 + 0.13 * k, 0]);
const PHONE_VIEW = new Map<string, { k: number; side: number }>();
/** The first lift / shoulder at which the head, neck and shoulders stay off the line to the phone (checked across the shot). */
const phoneView = (c: ShotCtx, s: Subject) => {
  const key = `${c.t0.toFixed(3)}:${c.t1.toFixed(3)}`;
  let v = PHONE_VIEW.get(key);
  if (v) return v;
  const ts = [0.25, 0.5, 0.8].map((f) => c.t0 + (c.t1 - c.t0) * f);
  const clear = (k: number, side: number) => ts.every((t) => {
    const h = s.head(t), yw = s.yaw(t), F = fwd(yw), Rt = right(yw), ph = s.phone?.(t) ?? s.hand(t), pos = legalCam(c.place, phoneCam(h, F, Rt, k, side));
    const neck = add(h, [0, -0.24, 0]), shoulder = add(add(h, [0, -0.34, 0]), Rt, 0.17 * side);
    return segDist(h, pos, ph) > 0.19 && segDist(neck, pos, ph) > 0.12 && segDist(shoulder, pos, ph) > 0.1;
  });
  v = { k: 5, side: 1 };
  search: for (let k = 0; k <= 5; k++) for (const side of [1, -1]) if (clear(k, side)) { v = { k, side }; break search; }
  PHONE_VIEW.set(key, v);
  return v;
};

function portraitRig(c: ShotCtx, t: number, u: number, s: Subject, tgt: V3 | undefined, rot: number, dk: number): Rig | null {
  const p = s.pos(t), h = s.head(t);
  const faceShot = c.kind === "cu" || c.kind === "ecu" || c.kind === "medium" || c.kind === "push";
  const ed = s.eye(t).dir, bodyYaw = s.yaw(t);
  const yaw = (faceShot && Math.hypot(ed[0], ed[2]) > 0.3 ? Math.atan2(ed[0], ed[2]) : bodyYaw) + rot, F = fwd(bodyYaw), Rt = right(bodyYaw);
  const at = (H: number, d: number, fovDeg: number, aim: V3, from: V3): Rig => ({ pos: from, target: aim, fov: c.fov ?? fovDeg, focus: h });
  const interior = c.place.kind === "interior";
  switch (c.kind) {
    case "wide": {
      // the whole figure in its place, a little high, more depth than width
      const a = yaw + c.side * 0.38, D = (interior ? 3.5 : 6.0) * dk, fv = interior ? 54 : 50;
      const pos = add(add(p, fwd(a), D), [0, 1.62 + 0.1 * u, 0]);
      return { pos: add(pos, Rt, 0.12 * u * c.side), target: add(p, [0, 0.95, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? fv, focus: h };
    }
    case "mediumWide": {
      const a = yaw + c.side * 0.34, D = (2.55 - 0.15 * u) * dk;
      return { pos: add(add(p, fwd(a), D), [0, 1.4, 0]), target: add(p, [0, 0.98, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? fovFor(2.1, D), focus: h };
    }
    case "medium": {
      // waist up, eyes on the upper third
      const a = yaw + c.side * 0.3, D = (1.55 - 0.12 * u) * dk;
      return at(1.25, D, fovFor(1.25, D), add(h, [0, -0.3, 0]), add(add(h, fwd(a), D), [0, -0.04, 0]));
    }
    case "cu": {
      const a = yaw + c.side * 0.24, D = (0.95 - 0.1 * u) * Math.max(0.8, dk);
      return at(0.64, D, fovFor(0.64, D), add(h, [0, -0.12, 0]), add(add(h, fwd(a), D), [0, 0.0, 0]));
    }
    case "ecu": {
      const e = s.eye(t), a = yaw + c.side * 0.14, D = 0.5 - 0.05 * u;
      return { pos: add(add(e.pos, fwd(a), D), [0, 0.01, 0]), target: add(e.pos, [0, -0.04, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? fovFor(0.32, D), focus: e.pos };
    }
    case "push": {
      const a = yaw + c.side * 0.2, D = (2.6 - 1.45 * u) * Math.max(0.75, dk);
      return at(1.0, D, fovFor(1.05, 2.0), add(h, [0, -0.18 - 0.06 * (1 - u), 0]), add(add(h, fwd(a), D), [0, -0.04, 0]));
    }
    case "pull": {
      const a = yaw + c.side * 0.24, D = 1.1 + 3.2 * u;
      return { pos: add(add(h, fwd(a), D), [0, 0.1 + 0.7 * u, 0]), target: add(h, [0, -0.28 - 0.35 * u, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? 46, focus: h };
    }
    case "profile": {
      const D = 2.0 * dk;
      return { pos: add(add(p, right(yaw), D * c.side), [0, 1.32, 0]), target: add(p, [0, 1.12, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? fovFor(1.75, D), focus: h };
    }
    case "low": return { pos: add(add(add(p, F, 1.75 * dk), Rt, 0.18 * c.side), [0, 0.45, 0]), target: add(h, [0, -0.05, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? 50, focus: h };
    case "high": return { pos: add(add(add(p, F, 1.3 * dk), Rt, 0.25 * c.side), [0, 3.1, 0]), target: add(p, [0, 0.6, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? 52, focus: h };
    case "lead": {
      const D = 2.4 * dk;
      return { pos: add(add(add(p, F, D), Rt, 0.14 * c.side), [0, 1.5, 0]), target: add(h, [0, -0.3, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? fovFor(1.9, D), focus: h };
    }
    case "track": {
      // from behind, close to the line of the path: the figure low in frame, the way ahead above it
      const pos = add(add(add(p, F, -2.0 * dk), Rt, 0.16 * c.side), [0, 1.68, 0]);
      return { pos, target: add(add(p, F, 2.6), [0, 1.15, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? 54, focus: h };
    }
    case "orbit": {
      const look = tgt && len(sub(tgt, h)) < 6 ? mix(h, tgt, 0.5) : h;
      const a = yaw + c.side * (0.35 + 0.45 * u), R = 2.0 * dk;
      return { pos: add(look, [Math.sin(a) * R, 0.2, Math.cos(a) * R]), target: add(look, [0, -0.15, 0]), fov: c.fov ?? 44, focus: look };
    }
    case "insert": {
      // a phone in the hand: over the shoulder onto its screen
      if (c.phone) {
        // behind the phone hand's shoulder, wide enough of the big head that the ear stays out of the lens; lifted and
        // swung out (or to the other shoulder) until head, neck and shoulder leave the line to the phone
        const ph = s.phone?.(t) ?? s.hand(t);
        const { k, side } = phoneView(c, s);
        const pos = phoneCam(h, F, Rt, k, side);
        return { pos, target: ph, fov: c.fov ?? 30 + 3 * k, focus: ph };
      }
      const hand = s.hand(t);
      // a thing the person looks at, not one in the hand (a QR code, a sign, a screen on the counter), near or
      // across the room: on the line from the eyes, close to its face; the person is behind the lens
      if (tgt && len(sub(tgt, hand)) > 0.45 && len(sub(tgt, h)) < 10) {
        const d = sub(tgt, h), dl = Math.hypot(d[0], d[2]) || 1, dn: V3 = [d[0] / dl, 0, d[2] / dl];
        const pos = add(add(tgt, dn, -0.75), [dn[2], 0, -dn[0]], 0.3 * c.side);
        return { pos: [pos[0], tgt[1] + 0.35, pos[2]], target: tgt, fov: c.fov ?? 36, focus: tgt };
      }
      // from above, hand + thing in the middle of the tall frame
      const aim = tgt && len(sub(tgt, h)) < 1.5 ? (len(sub(tgt, hand)) < 0.8 ? mix(tgt, hand, 0.45) : tgt) : hand;
      const rt = right(yaw), fw = fwd(yaw), hd = sub(hand, h), hs = Math.sign(hd[0] * rt[0] + hd[2] * rt[2]) || c.side;
      const sk = Math.min(2.6, Math.max(1, (c.size ?? 0) / 0.18));
      const pos = add(add(add(aim, rt, 0.16 * hs * sk), fw, 0.26 * sk), [0, 0.52 * sk, 0]);
      return { pos, target: aim, fov: c.fov ?? 46, focus: aim };
    }
    case "ots": {
      // close behind the shoulder, almost on the line of sight: the shoulder is a dark edge low in frame
      const look = tgt ?? add(h, F, 6);
      const far = len(sub(look, h)) > 15;
      const back = sub(h, look), bn = len(back) || 1;
      const up = look[1] - h[1], low = up > 0.6;
      const pos = add(add(add(h, [back[0] / bn, 0, back[2] / bn], 1.5), Rt, 0.38 * c.side), [0, low ? 0.12 - Math.min(0.45, up * 0.22) : 0.24, 0]);
      return { pos, target: mix(look, h, low ? 0.12 : 0), fov: c.fov ?? (far ? 30 : low ? 46 : 40), focus: look };
    }
    case "reveal": {
      const look = tgt ?? add(h, F, 10);
      const back = sub(h, look), bn = len(back) || 1;
      const pos = add(add(add(h, [back[0] / bn, 0, back[2] / bn], 1.55), Rt, 0.34 * c.side), [0, 0.2, 0]);
      const k = ease((t - c.t0 - 0.4) / Math.max(0.5, (c.t1 - c.t0) * 0.6));
      return { pos, target: mix(mix(h, look, 0.2), look, k), fov: c.fov ?? 44, focus: k < 0.5 ? h : look };
    }
    case "twoShot": {
      // staggered in depth: past the first person's shoulder onto the second one's face
      if (!c.subj2) return null;
      const h2 = c.subj2.head(t), d = sub(h, h2), dn = Math.hypot(d[0], d[2]) || 1;
      const dir: V3 = [d[0] / dn, 0, d[2] / dn], perp: V3 = [-dir[2] * c.side, 0, dir[0] * c.side];
      const pos = add(add(add(h, dir, 1.0 * dk), perp, 0.32), [0, 0.12, 0]);
      return { pos, target: mix(add(h2, [0, -0.18, 0]), h, 0.22), fov: c.fov ?? 46, focus: h2 };
    }
    case "establish": case "drone": {
      const E = c.place.establish;
      const a = E.yaw + c.side * 0.12 * u + rot, R = E.radius * dk * (c.kind === "drone" ? 1.5 - 0.25 * u : 0.95 - 0.15 * u), H = E.height * (c.kind === "drone" ? 1.9 - 0.4 * u : 1.15 - 0.3 * u);
      return { pos: add(E.center, [Math.sin(a) * R, H, Math.cos(a) * R]), target: mix(E.center, h, 0.55), fov: c.fov ?? 56, focus: h };
    }
    case "long": {
      const look = tgt ?? add(h, F, 30);
      const from = add(add(h, Rt, 0.18 * c.side), [0, 0.05, 0]);
      const d = len(sub(look, from));
      const fv = Math.max(4, Math.min(40, (2 * Math.atan2(d > 60 ? 12 : 4.2, d) * 180) / Math.PI));
      return { pos: from, target: look, fov: c.fov ?? fv * (1 - 0.08 * u), focus: look };
    }
    case "pov": {
      const e = s.eye(t), look = tgt ?? add(e.pos, e.dir, 8);
      const far = len(sub(look, e.pos)) > 15;
      return { pos: add(e.pos, F, 0.06), target: look, fov: c.fov ?? (far ? 32 : 50), focus: look };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

// ── framing checks (shared by the candidate search and the preflight) ─────────────────────────────────
/** camera basis + projection of a world point to the frame: x, y in −1…1 inside the picture, z = depth */
export const frameOf = (pos: V3, target: V3, fov: number, aspect: number) => {
  const f = sub(target, pos), fl = len(f) || 1;
  const F: V3 = [f[0] / fl, f[1] / fl, f[2] / fl];
  let R: V3 = [F[2], 0, -F[0]];
  const rl = Math.hypot(R[0], R[2]) || 1;
  R = [-R[0] / rl, 0, -R[2] / rl];
  const U: V3 = [R[1] * F[2] - R[2] * F[1], R[2] * F[0] - R[0] * F[2], R[0] * F[1] - R[1] * F[0]];
  const th = Math.tan((fov * Math.PI) / 360);
  const project = (w: V3) => { const d = sub(w, pos); const z = d[0] * F[0] + d[1] * F[1] + d[2] * F[2]; return { x: (d[0] * R[0] + d[1] * R[1] + d[2] * R[2]) / (z * th * aspect), y: (d[0] * U[0] + d[1] * U[1] + d[2] * U[2]) / (z * th), z }; };
  const ray = (x: number, y: number): V3 => { const v: V3 = [F[0] + R[0] * x * th * aspect + U[0] * y * th, F[1] + R[1] * x * th * aspect + U[1] * y * th, F[2] + R[2] * x * th * aspect + U[2] * y * th]; const l = len(v); return [v[0] / l, v[1] / l, v[2] / l]; };
  return { project, ray };
};
/** distance along a ray to a box (Infinity = miss); a ray starting inside the box never hits it */
const rayBox = (o: V3, d: V3, bx: { min: V3; max: V3 }) => {
  let t0 = 0, t1 = Infinity;
  for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
    if (Math.abs(d[k]) < 1e-9) { if (o[k] < bx.min[k] || o[k] > bx.max[k]) return Infinity; continue; }
    let a = (bx.min[k] - o[k]) / d[k], b = (bx.max[k] - o[k]) / d[k];
    if (a > b) [a, b] = [b, a];
    t0 = Math.max(t0, a); t1 = Math.min(t1, b);
    if (t0 > t1) return Infinity;
  }
  return t0 > 1e-4 ? t0 : Infinity;
};
/** distance along a ray to the inside wall of a room box the ray starts in */
const rayExit = (o: V3, d: V3, bx: { min: V3; max: V3 }) => {
  let t = Infinity;
  for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) { if (d[k] > 1e-9) t = Math.min(t, (bx.max[k] - o[k]) / d[k]); else if (d[k] < -1e-9) t = Math.min(t, (bx.min[k] - o[k]) / d[k]); }
  return Math.max(0, t);
};
/** Share of the picture covered by a surface right at the lens (a wall in a narrow corridor, a shelf edge, a
 *  door frame): rays through a grid of the frame, near = closer than 30 % of the focus distance (at least
 *  22 cm, at most 60 cm). Foreground furniture further away is composition, not an obstruction. */
export const nearCover = (place: Place, pos: V3, target: V3, fov: number, aspect: number, focusD: number, grid: [number, number] = aspect < 1 ? [4, 7] : [7, 4]) =>
  coverOf(place, pos, target, fov, aspect, focusD, grid).near;
/** near: share of rays hitting a surface right at the lens; fg: share hitting anything nearer than 85 % of the
 *  focus distance (an open door leaf, a wall running past the lens, furniture in front of the person) */
export const coverOf = (place: Place, pos: V3, target: V3, fov: number, aspect: number, focusD: number, grid: [number, number] = aspect < 1 ? [4, 7] : [7, 4]) => {
  const fr = frameOf(pos, target, fov, aspect);
  const lim = Math.min(0.6, Math.max(0.22, 0.3 * focusD)), fgLim = 0.85 * focusD;
  const boxes = [...place.solids, ...(place.occluders ?? []), ...(place.kind === "interior" ? [...(place.soft ?? []), ...(place.swings ?? [])] : [])].filter((b) => !inside(pos, b));
  const room = place.kind === "interior" ? (place.zones?.find((z) => inside(pos, z)) ?? (inside(pos, place.box) ? place.box : undefined)) : undefined;
  let near = 0, fg = 0, n = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < grid[0]; i++) for (let j = 0; j < grid[1]; j++) {
    const x = -0.9 + (1.8 * (i + 0.5)) / grid[0], y = -0.9 + (1.8 * (j + 0.5)) / grid[1];
    const d = fr.ray(x, y);
    let hit = room ? rayExit(pos, d, room) : Infinity;
    for (const b of boxes) { if (hit < lim) break; hit = Math.min(hit, rayBox(pos, d, b)); }
    // the floor is not an obstruction (a high shot looks down at it on purpose)
    n++;
    if (d[1] < -0.35) continue;
    if (hit < lim) near++;
    if (hit < fgLim) fg++;
  }
  return { near: n ? near / n : 0, fg: n ? fg / n : 0 };
};

// framings placed around the subject: if the ideal spot is inside a wall/furniture, swing around the
// subject (once per shot, so the camera never jumps mid-shot) until the spot is free
const ORBITS: ShotName[] = ["wide", "mediumWide", "medium", "cu", "ecu", "profile", "low", "high", "push", "pull", "lead", "orbit", "insert", "twoShot"];
const SIDED: ShotName[] = ["long", "ots", "reveal", "track"];

/** Does the segment a→b pass through the box (shrunk by m)? (slab test) */
const hitsBox = (a: V3, b: V3, bx: { min: V3; max: V3 }, m = 0.03) => {
  let t0 = 0, t1 = 1;
  for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
    const d = b[k] - a[k], lo = bx.min[k] + m, hi = bx.max[k] - m;
    if (Math.abs(d) < 1e-9) { if (a[k] < lo || a[k] > hi) return false; continue; }
    let u0 = (lo - a[k]) / d, u1 = (hi - a[k]) / d;
    if (u0 > u1) [u0, u1] = [u1, u0];
    t0 = Math.max(t0, u0); t1 = Math.min(t1, u1);
    if (t0 > t1) return false;
  }
  return t1 > 0.02 && t0 < 0.98;
};
const inside = (p: V3, bx: { min: V3; max: V3 }) => p[0] > bx.min[0] && p[0] < bx.max[0] && p[1] > bx.min[1] && p[1] < bx.max[1] && p[2] > bx.min[2] && p[2] < bx.max[2];
/** distance from point p to segment a→b */
const segDist = (p: V3, a: V3, b: V3) => {
  const ab = sub(b, a), ap = sub(p, a), L = ab[0] * ab[0] + ab[1] * ab[1] + ab[2] * ab[2] || 1;
  const k = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (ap[0] * ab[0] + ap[1] * ab[1] + ap[2] * ab[2]) / L));
  return len(sub(p, add(a, ab, k)));
};

/** How bad a framing is at a few moments: camera pushed by walls/furniture, view blocked by walls,
 *  furniture or the subject's own head. Lower is better. */
const dbg = (k: string, v: number) => { const g = globalThis as { __shotDebug?: Record<string, number> }; if (g.__shotDebug && v) g.__shotDebug[k] = (g.__shotDebug[k] ?? 0) + v; };
const badness = (c: ShotCtx, rot: number, flip: number, dk = 1) => {
  let bad = 0;
  const cc = flip !== 1 ? { ...c, side: (c.side * flip) as 1 | -1 } : c;
  for (const k of [0.15, 0.5, 0.85]) {
    const t = c.t0 + (c.t1 - c.t0) * k, q = rig(cc, t, c.subj ? rot * cc.side : rot, dk);
    const pos = legalCam(c.place, q.pos);
    bad += len(sub(pos, q.pos)) * 2; dbg("pushed by walls", len(sub(pos, q.pos)) * 2);
    const look = q.focus ?? q.target;
    const head = c.subj ? c.subj.head(t) : undefined;
    // what must be seen: the subject's head (people shots) and the target (shots aimed at something)
    const musts: V3[] = [];
    if (head && c.kind !== "long" && c.kind !== "pov") musts.push(head);
    // nobody in shot: what it shows must be seen
    if (!head && c.target && c.kind !== "map") musts.push(look);
    // body shots: the chest too (a post or a shelf across the torso spoils a medium-wide)
    if (head && (c.kind === "mediumWide" || c.kind === "wide" || c.kind === "medium" || c.kind === "twoShot")) musts.push([head[0], head[1] - 0.45, head[2]]);
    if (c.kind === "long" || c.kind === "ots" || c.kind === "reveal" || c.kind === "insert") musts.push(look);
    const people = (c.others?.(t) ?? []).map((p) => ({ min: [p[0] - 0.25, p[1], p[2] - 0.25] as V3, max: [p[0] + 0.25, p[1] + 1.75, p[2] + 0.25] as V3 }));
    // the lens at another person (a cashier behind the counter): the line-of-sight test below skips a box the
    // camera is inside, so their head would fill the frame unseen
    for (const b of people) if (Math.hypot(pos[0] - (b.min[0] + b.max[0]) / 2, pos[2] - (b.min[2] + b.max[2]) / 2) < 0.45 && pos[1] < b.max[1] + 0.2) { bad += 3; dbg("camera at a person", 3); }
    for (const m of musts) {
      for (const s of [...c.place.solids, ...(c.place.occluders ?? []), ...people]) {
        if (inside(m, s) || inside(pos, s)) continue;
        // grown by 5 cm: a thin post that only just misses the line still covers the face on screen
        if (hitsBox(pos, m, s, -0.05)) { bad += 1.5; dbg(`blocked ${m === head ? "head" : "target"}`, 1.5); break; }
      }
    }
    // portrait (and landscape) framing: what must be seen has to be inside the picture, and no near surface
    // may cover it (a wall at the lens in a narrow corridor)
    const asp = c.aspect ?? 16 / 9;
    const fr = frameOf(pos, q.target, q.fov, asp);
    const PEOPLE = ["wide", "mediumWide", "medium", "cu", "push", "pull", "profile", "low", "high", "lead", "orbit", "twoShot", "track", "establish"];
    const inFrame = [...new Set(musts)].filter((m) => m !== head || PEOPLE.includes(c.kind));
    for (const m of inFrame) {
      const pj = fr.project(m);
      if (pj.z <= 0.05) { bad += 3; continue; }
      const ox = Math.abs(pj.x) - 0.86, oy = Math.abs(pj.y) - 0.9;
      if (ox > 0) { bad += 1 + ox * 3; dbg("out of frame x", 1 + ox * 3); }
      if (oy > 0) { bad += 0.6 + oy * 2; dbg("out of frame y", 0.6 + oy * 2); }
    }
    if (c.kind !== "pov" && c.kind !== "ecu") {
      const fd = len(sub(look, pos));
      const cv = coverOf(c.place, pos, q.target, q.fov, asp, fd, asp < 1 ? [3, 5] : [5, 3]);
      if (cv.near > 0.22) bad += (cv.near - 0.22) * 9;
      if (head && PEOPLE.includes(c.kind) && cv.fg > 0.4) bad += (cv.fg - 0.4) * 6;
      // portrait: the person a shot is about stays near the middle of the narrow frame
      if (asp < 1 && head && !["ots", "reveal", "long", "insert", "pov", "twoShot", "track"].includes(c.kind)) { const hx = Math.abs(fr.project(head).x); if (hx > 0.42) bad += (hx - 0.42) * 1.6; }
    }
    // a face shot shows the face: the camera in front of / beside where the face looks, never behind the head
    if (head && c.subj && (c.kind === "cu" || c.kind === "ecu" || c.kind === "medium" || c.kind === "push")) {
      const e = c.subj.eye(t).dir, el = Math.hypot(e[0], e[2]) || 1, v = sub(pos, head), vl = Math.hypot(v[0], v[2]) || 1;
      const facing = (e[0] * v[0] + e[2] * v[2]) / (el * vl);
      if (facing < 0.05) { bad += 1.2 + (0.05 - facing) * 3; dbg("behind the face", 1.2 + (0.05 - facing) * 3); }
      // a profile from behind hides the face (hair covers the cheek): close-ups want ≤ 63° off the gaze, mediums ≤ 65°
      else { const lim = c.kind === "cu" || c.kind === "ecu" ? 0.45 : 0.42; if (facing < lim) { bad += (lim - facing) * 3; dbg("face turned away", (lim - facing) * 3); } }
    }
    // over the shoulder in a narrow frame: the head is an edge, not the picture
    if (head && asp < 1 && (c.kind === "ots" || c.kind === "reveal")) {
      const hd = len(sub(head, pos)), half = Math.tan((q.fov * Math.PI) / 360) * asp;
      const frac = 0.13 / Math.max(0.05, hd) / half;
      if (frac > 0.5) { bad += (frac - 0.5) * 4; dbg("head too big", (frac - 0.5) * 4); }
    }
    // the subject's own head in front of the lens on shots aimed past them
    if (head && (c.kind === "long" || c.kind === "ots" || c.kind === "insert" || c.kind === "reveal") && segDist(head, pos, look) < (c.kind === "long" ? 0.26 : c.kind === "insert" ? 0.16 : c.kind === "reveal" ? 0.18 : 0.12)) { bad += 3; dbg("own head in the lens", 3); }
    if (head && c.kind === "insert" && len(sub(pos, head)) < 0.22) bad += 3;
  }
  return bad;
};

type Pick = { rot: number; flip: number; dk: number; from?: V3 };
/** development aid: the score of a candidate framing (lower is better) */
export const scoreFraming = (c: ShotCtx, rot: number, flip: number, dk: number) => badness(c, rot, flip, dk);
export const pickOf = (c: ShotCtx) => pick(c);
const pickCache = new WeakMap<ShotCtx, Pick>();
const pick = (c: ShotCtx): Pick => {
  const hit = pickCache.get(c);
  if (hit) return hit;
  let best: Pick = { rot: 0, flip: 1, dk: 1 }, bestB = Infinity;
  if (c.subj && ORBITS.includes(c.kind)) {
    outer: for (const dk of [1, 0.75, 0.55]) {
      for (const r of [0, 0.45, -0.45, 0.9, -0.9, 1.35, -1.35, 1.9, -1.9, Math.PI]) {
        const b = badness(c, r, 1, dk) + (1 - dk) * 0.6;
        if (b < 0.1) { best = { rot: r, flip: 1, dk }; bestB = b; break outer; }
        if (b < bestB - 0.05) { best = { rot: r, flip: 1, dk }; bestB = b; }
      }
    }
    best = { ...best, rot: best.rot * c.side };
  } else if (!c.subj && c.kind !== "map") {
    // nobody in shot (a place, a thing): swing around the establishing ring and pull in until the view is clear
    outer2: for (const dk of [1, 0.8, 0.62]) {
      for (const r of [0, 0.35, -0.35, 0.7, -0.7, 1.15, -1.15, 1.7, -1.7, Math.PI]) {
        const b = badness(c, r, 1, dk) + (1 - dk) * 0.9 + Math.abs(r) * 0.18;
        if (b < 0.1) { best = { rot: r, flip: 1, dk }; bestB = b; break outer2; }
        if (b < bestB - 0.05) { best = { rot: r, flip: 1, dk }; bestB = b; }
      }
    }
  } else if (c.subj && SIDED.includes(c.kind)) {
    const a = badness(c, 0, 1), b = badness(c, 0, -1);
    best = b < a - 0.05 ? { rot: 0, flip: -1, dk: 1 } : { rot: 0, flip: 1, dk: 1 };
    bestB = Math.min(a, b);
    if (bestB >= 2.5 && c.target && c.kind !== "track") {
      // the subject cannot see it: find a clear vantage point (marks of the place at eye height)
      const tm = (c.t0 + c.t1) / 2, look = c.target(tm), me = c.subj.pos(tm);
      const blockers = [...c.place.solids, ...(c.place.occluders ?? [])];
      const cands = Object.values(c.place.marks).map((m) => [m.p[0], (m.y ?? c.place.floor) + 1.55, m.p[1]] as V3)
        .filter((q) => { const d = len(sub(look, q)); return d > 2.5 && d < 40 && segDist(c.subj!.head(tm), q, look) > 0.6 && !blockers.some((bx) => !inside(look, bx) && hitsBox(q, look, bx)); })
        .sort((q1, q2) => len(sub(q1, me)) - len(sub(q2, me)));
      if (cands[0]) best = { rot: 0, flip: 1, dk: 1, from: legalCam(c.place, cands[0]) };
    }
  }
  pickCache.set(c, best);
  return best;
};

export const shotCam = (c0: ShotCtx, t: number): Cam => {
  const pk = pick(c0);
  const c = pk.flip !== 1 ? { ...c0, side: (c0.side * pk.flip) as 1 | -1 } : c0;
  const r = rig(c, t, pk.rot, pk.dk, pk.from);
  const k = SHAKE[c.mood] * (SHAKE_K[c.kind] ?? 1);
  let pos: V3 = [r.pos[0] + k * 0.012 * n1(t, 1 + c.seed), r.pos[1] + k * 0.01 * n1(t, 2 + c.seed), r.pos[2] + k * 0.012 * n1(t, 3 + c.seed)];
  if (c.kind !== "pov" && !r.free) pos = legalCam(c.place, pos);
  const target: V3 = [r.target[0] + k * 0.03 * n1(t, 4 + c.seed), r.target[1] + k * 0.025 * n1(t, 5 + c.seed), r.target[2] + k * 0.03 * n1(t, 6 + c.seed)];
  const f = r.focus ?? r.target;
  const ap = APERTURE[c.kind] ?? 0.0015;
  return { pos, target, fov: r.fov, roll: k * 0.006 * n1(t, 7 + c.seed), focus: Math.max(0.3, len(sub(f, pos))), aperture: ap, maxBlur: ap > 0.005 ? 0.01 : 0.005, near: c.kind === "ecu" || c.kind === "insert" ? 0.02 : 0.05 };
};

/** The framing to use instead when the same framing would repeat. */
export const ALT: Record<ShotName, ShotName> = {
  establish: "wide", drone: "establish", wide: "mediumWide", mediumWide: "medium", medium: "cu", cu: "medium", ecu: "medium", ots: "long", pov: "cu",
  long: "ots", track: "lead", lead: "profile", profile: "medium", low: "medium", high: "mediumWide", insert: "medium", orbit: "medium", push: "cu",
  pull: "wide", reveal: "long", map: "establish", twoShot: "medium",
};

==== 5586 project/src/director/story.ts
// story.json — the ONE file written per video. Everything else (blocking, acting, cameras, light, grade,
// letterbox, UI, sound) is derived from it by the director (compile.ts). Plain data, validated with
// plain-language errors (validate.ts). Cues: a spoken word ("cahaya", "cahaya#1" = its 2nd occurrence,
// 0-based) or a number = VO seconds.

import type { CustomLook } from "../cine/character/looks.ts";
import type { HoldKind } from "../cine/character/pose.ts";

export type Cue = string | number;
export type Word = [string, number, number];

export const MOODS = ["mystery", "tense", "calm", "memory", "told", "reveal", "science", "warm", "cctv"] as const;
export type Mood = (typeof MOODS)[number];
export const CUTS = ["cut", "fade", "dip", "flash"] as const;
export type Transition = (typeof CUTS)[number];

export const ACTIONS = [
  "stand", "look", "turn", "walk", "run", "startle", "freeze", "peer", "point", "reach", "wave",
  "phone", "binoculars", "raise", "think", "nod", "shake", "sigh", "talk", "shiver",
  "sit", "standUp", "write", "lie", "sleep", "wake", "sitUp",
  "push", "pickUp", "putDown", "give", "receive", "open", "close", "kneel",
] as const;
export type ActionName = (typeof ACTIONS)[number];

export const SHOTS = [
  "establish", "drone", "wide", "mediumWide", "medium", "cu", "ecu", "ots", "pov", "long", "track", "lead", "profile",
  "low", "high", "insert", "orbit", "push", "pull", "reveal", "map", "twoShot",
] as const;
export type ShotName = (typeof SHOTS)[number];

export const FACES = ["neutral", "calm", "alert", "fear", "panic", "squint", "read", "sleep", "drowsy", "smile", "laugh", "sad", "think", "uneasy", "serious", "relief", "surprised", "curious"] as const;
export type FaceName = (typeof FACES)[number];

export const PROPS = ["phone", "binoculars", "lantern", "flashlight", "mug", "book"] as const;
export type PropName = (typeof PROPS)[number];
export type { HoldKind };

export type Ui =
  | { type: "title"; text: string; sub?: string; kicker?: string }
  | { type: "lower"; text: string; sub?: string }
  | { type: "tag"; text: string; sub?: string; pos?: "tl" | "tr" | "bl" | "br" | "c" }
  | { type: "callout"; text: string; sub?: string; poi: string }
  | { type: "card"; title?: string; lines: string[]; pos?: "l" | "r" }
  | { type: "stamp"; text: string }
  | { type: "clock"; text: string; sub?: string }
  | { type: "steps"; items: string[] };

export type ShotSpec = { type: ShotName; subject?: string; target?: string; side?: "left" | "right"; fov?: number };

export type Beat = {
  at: Cue;
  /** optional end (otherwise the next beat / scene end) */
  until?: Cue;
  do?: ActionName;
  who?: string | string[];
  /** a mark name (walk/run/sit destination) */
  to?: string;
  /** what to look at / point at / show: a POI name, a mark, or a cast id */
  target?: string;
  /** a camera-only beat: show this POI or person (no acting needed) */
  show?: string;
  face?: FaceName;
  shot?: ShotName | ShotSpec;
  set?: Record<string, number>;
  /** seconds for set changes to fade (default 0.6) */
  fade?: number;
  sfx?: string | string[];
  ui?: Ui | Ui[];
  /** music accent + sound hit on this beat */
  hit?: boolean;
  /** music drops out during this beat */
  quiet?: boolean;
  /** an object moves on its own (rolling, sliding): to a mark / POI / [x, z], over `dur` seconds */
  move?: { obj: string; to: string | [number, number]; dur?: number; yaw?: number };
  /** what the action handles: the object pushed / picked up / given, or the door opened */
  obj?: string;
};

export type SceneCast = { at: string; do?: "stand" | "sit" | "lie"; face?: FaceName; /** object id held in the hand from the scene start */ holding?: string };

export type Scene = {
  at: Cue;
  place: string;
  time?: string;
  mood?: Mood;
  set?: Record<string, number>;
  cast?: Record<string, SceneCast>;
  cut?: Transition;
  beats: Beat[];
};

export type CastMember = {
  id: string; look: string; name?: string; custom?: CustomLook; prop?: PropName;
  /** what the phone shows when this person reads it ("phone" action) */
  phoneText?: { from?: string; text?: string; time?: string; date?: string };
};

export type Story = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  /** resolved by make.mjs when `world` names a world.json (dynamic world) */
  worldSpec?: import("../gen/spec.ts").WorldSpec;
  objectSpecs?: import("../gen/spec.ts").ObjectSpec[];
  vo: { file: string; offset?: number };
  words: string | Word[];
  world: string;
  cast: CastMember[];
  scenes: Scene[];
  titleCard?: { at: Cue; until?: Cue; text: string; sub?: string; kicker?: string };
  disclaimer?: { at: Cue; until?: Cue; text: string };
  endCard?: { text?: string; sub?: string; seconds?: number };
  /** seconds of picture after the VO ends before the end card (default 1.2) */
  tail?: number;
  /** VO loudness envelope (filled in by make.mjs; 60 values per second) */
  voenv?: number[];
  /** the mixed soundtrack in public/ (filled in by make.mjs once the sound step ran) */
  audio?: string;
  /** "portrait" 1080×1920 (default) or "landscape" 1920×1080 */
  format?: "portrait" | "landscape";
  /** "burn" = captions in the picture (portrait default), "off" = only the .srt (landscape default) */
  captions?: "burn" | "off";
  /** the user's brand kit (aibijan-brand.json), resolved by make.mjs; false in story.json = no branding */
  brand?: { brand?: string; handle?: string; cta?: string; colors?: { primary?: string; accent?: string; background?: string }; logoFile?: string; watermark?: boolean; intro?: { seconds?: number } };
};

==== 4854 project/src/film/Film.tsx
// One generic renderer for every story: compile once, then per frame — scene, set state, light rig
// (+ props carried by people), the world's set, the people, the camera, the grade, the overlay, audio.

import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { Html5Audio, staticFile, useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig } from "remotion";
import { Stage } from "../cine/Stage.tsx";
import { Lights, type LightState } from "../cine/Lights.tsx";
import { CameraRig, FilmPost } from "../cine/Post.tsx";
import { Character } from "../cine/character/Character.tsx";
import { fromChest } from "../cine/character/rig.ts";
import { phys } from "../cine/mats.ts";
import { phoneScreenTex, type PhoneMsg } from "../cine/set/tex.ts";
import { compile } from "../director/compile.ts";
import type { Story } from "../director/story.ts";
import { SETS } from "../worlds/sets.tsx";
import { studioLight } from "../worlds/studio/data.ts";
import { MindStudio } from "../worlds/studio/Mind.tsx";
import { GenSet } from "../gen/GenSet.tsx";
import { FilmOverlay } from "./Overlay.tsx";

const phoneScreen = (msg?: PhoneMsg) => phys(`phoneOn${JSON.stringify(msg ?? {})}`, { color: "#000000", emissive: "#ffffff", emissiveMap: phoneScreenTex("notif", msg), emissiveIntensity: 0.62, roughness: 0.08, clearcoat: 1 });

export const Film: React.FC<{ story: Story; audio?: string }> = ({ story, audio }) => {
  const plan = useMemo(() => compile(story), [story]);
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const { fps } = useVideoConfig();
  const t = frame / fps;
  const S = plan.sceneAt(t);
  const shot = plan.shotAt(t);
  const cam = plan.cam(t);
  const s = plan.setAt(t);
  const Set = SETS[plan.world.id] ?? (() => null);
  const people = S.cast.map((who) => ({ who, p: plan.poseOf(who, t) })).filter((x) => x.p);
  const studio = S.place.kind === "studio";
  let L: LightState = studio ? studioLight() : plan.world.light(S.place.id, S.time, s, t);
  // light carried by people: a lantern glows (point 4), a flashlight throws a spot (spot 1)
  for (const { who, p } of people) {
    if (!p?.hold) continue;
    const hand = fromChest(p, p.armR.ik && p.armR.ik.w > 0.3 ? [-p.armR.ik.t[0], p.armR.ik.t[1], p.armR.ik.t[2]] : [-0.2, -0.4, 0.1], plan.specs[who]);
    if (p.hold.kind === "lantern") L = { ...L, pts: [L.pts[0], L.pts[1], L.pts[2], L.pts[3], { pos: [hand[0], hand[1] - 0.15, hand[2]], color: "#ffb45e", i: 2.4, dist: 6 }, L.pts[5]] };
    if (p.hold.kind === "flashlight") {
      const f = [Math.sin(p.yaw), 0, Math.cos(p.yaw)];
      const aim: [number, number, number] = p.aim ?? [hand[0] + f[0] * 6, hand[1] - 0.9, hand[2] + f[2] * 6];
      L = { ...L, spots: [L.spots[0], { pos: hand, target: aim, color: "#fff4dc", i: 55, angle: 0.3, penumbra: 0.55, dist: 26 }] };
    }
  }
  // overview shots (establish, drone, map) see through the haze a little more: cinematic licence
  if (shot.kind === "map" || shot.kind === "drone" || shot.kind === "establish") L = { ...L, fog: { ...L.fog, density: L.fog.density * 0.45 } };
  const pov = shot.kind === "pov" ? shot.who : undefined;
  // portrait / phone: a soft eye-light from the camera side on the subject's face in dark scenes, short
  // reach (it lights the face, not the room) — the night stays dark, the face reads on a small screen
  let fill = { pos: [0, -60, 0] as [number, number, number], i: 0 };
  const fp = shot.who ? people.find((x) => x.who === shot.who)?.p : undefined;
  if (plan.format === "portrait" && fp && S.dark > 0.3 && !studio && !["pov", "long", "establish", "drone", "map"].includes(shot.kind)) {
    const head: [number, number, number] = [fp.x, fp.y + 1.45 + fp.hipY, fp.z];
    const d = [cam.pos[0] - head[0], cam.pos[1] - head[1], cam.pos[2] - head[2]], dl = Math.hypot(d[0], d[1], d[2]) || 1;
    const k = Math.min(1.1, dl);
    fill = { pos: [head[0] + (d[0] / dl) * k, head[1] + (d[1] / dl) * k + 0.28, head[2] + (d[2] / dl) * k], i: 1.5 * Math.min(1, S.dark) };
  }
  return (
    <Stage overlay={() => <FilmOverlay plan={plan} t={t} cam={cam} />}>
      <Lights s={L} />
      <pointLight position={fill.pos} intensity={fill.i} distance={3.2} decay={2} color="#dfe8ff" />
      {studio ? <MindStudio t={t} /> : plan.built ? (
        <GenSet b={plan.built} place={S.place.id} time={S.time} s={s} t={t} cam={cam} dyn={plan.objectsAt(t)} area={[S.place.box.min[0], S.place.box.min[2], S.place.box.max[0], S.place.box.max[2]]} />
      ) : <Set place={S.place.id} time={S.time} s={s} t={t} cam={cam} />}
      {people.map(({ who, p }) => <Character key={who} spec={plan.specs[who]} pose={p!} t={t} visible={who !== pov} phoneScreen={phoneScreen(plan.story.cast.find((c) => c.id === who)?.phoneText)} />)}
      <CameraRig cam={cam} />
      <FilmPost cam={cam} grade={plan.grade(t)} frame={frame} />
      {audio ? <Html5Audio src={staticFile(audio)} /> : null}
    </Stage>
  );
};

==== 15999 project/src/film/Overlay.tsx
// 2D layer over the picture, laid out for the frame's orientation: portrait 1080 × 1920 (default) or
// landscape 1920 × 1080. Portrait keeps everything inside the TikTok / Reels safe area (top 230 px, bottom
// 420 px and the right-hand button column stay clear), shades top and bottom instead of letterbox bars and
// burns in short word-timed captions. The story's UI overlays (titles, lower thirds, tags, callouts on 3D
// points, cards, stamps, clock, steps), title card, disclaimer and end card; branding only from the user's
// own brand kit (story.brand, resolved by make.mjs) — intro, outro and an optional watermark.

import React from "react";
import { AbsoluteFill, Img, interpolate, staticFile } from "remotion";
import { AMBER, Callout, Card, CYAN, Flow, INK, Lower, span, Stamp, Tag, Title, Clock } from "../cine/ui.tsx";
import type { Cam } from "../cine/Post.tsx";
import type { Plan, UiP } from "../director/compile.ts";
import { project } from "./project.ts";

const FONT = "Manrope, sans-serif";
const ease = (x: number) => { const k = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, x)); return k * k * (3 - 2 * k); };

type Pos = "tl" | "tr" | "bl" | "br" | "c";
type Lay = {
  W: number; H: number; portrait: boolean;
  safe: { l: number; r: number; t: number; b: number };
  pos: Record<Pos, [number, number]>;
  lower: { x: number; y: number; size: number };
  card: { y: number; w: number; title: number; line: number };
  stamp: [number, number]; title: { y: number; size: number }; clock: number;
  steps: { x: number; y: number; w: number; vertical: boolean };
  cap: { y: number; size: number; w: number };
  tag: number;
};
const PORTRAIT: Lay = {
  W: 1080, H: 1920, portrait: true,
  safe: { l: 72, r: 930, t: 230, b: 1500 },
  pos: { tl: [72, 320], tr: [930, 320], bl: [72, 1110], br: [930, 1110], c: [501, 860] },
  lower: { x: 72, y: 1190, size: 50 },
  card: { y: 330, w: 858, title: 36, line: 34 },
  stamp: [501, 1010], title: { y: 820, size: 66 }, clock: 980,
  steps: { x: 501, y: 460, w: 640, vertical: true },
  cap: { y: 1335, size: 58, w: 840 },
  tag: 30,
};
const LANDSCAPE: Lay = {
  W: 1920, H: 1080, portrait: false,
  safe: { l: 120, r: 1800, t: 90, b: 990 },
  pos: { tl: [140, 200], tr: [1780, 200], bl: [140, 840], br: [1780, 840], c: [960, 540] },
  lower: { x: 120, y: 860, size: 40 },
  card: { y: 300, w: 600, title: 30, line: 27 },
  stamp: [1450, 300], title: { y: 540, size: 84 }, clock: 540,
  steps: { x: 960, y: 540, w: 300, vertical: false },
  cap: { y: 935, size: 44, w: 1400 },
  tag: 26,
};

export const Letterbox: React.FC<{ k: number }> = ({ k }) => {
  const bar = interpolate(k, [0, 1], [0, (1080 - 1920 / 2.2) / 2]);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: "none" }}>
      <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 0, right: 0, top: 0, height: bar, background: "#000" }} />
      <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, height: bar, background: "#000" }} />
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

/** portrait: soft shade under the app's top bar and behind the captions — the picture stays full height */
const PortraitShade: React.FC = () => (
  <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: "none" }}>
    <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 0, right: 0, top: 0, height: 320, background: "linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.42), rgba(0,0,0,0))" }} />
    <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, height: 760, background: "linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0), rgba(0,0,0,0.5))" }} />
  </AbsoluteFill>
);

/** the subject's face on screen (overlay pixels): text keeps off it */
type Face = { top: number; bottom: number; left: number; right: number } | null;
const faceOf = (plan: Plan, t: number, cam: Cam, L: Lay): Face => {
  const sh = plan.shotAt(t);
  if (!sh.who || sh.kind === "pov") return null;
  const p = plan.poseOf(sh.who, t);
  if (!p) return null;
  const c = project(cam, [p.x, p.y + 1.5 + p.hipY, p.z], L.W, L.H);
  if (c.z <= 0.05) return null;
  const r = (0.16 / c.z / Math.tan((cam.fov * Math.PI) / 360)) * (L.H / 2);
  return { top: c.y - r * 1.25, bottom: c.y + r * 1.35, left: c.x - r, right: c.x + r };
};
/** move a block of text (centre y, height h) off the face: below it when there is room, else above it */
const avoid = (y: number, h: number, f: Face, L: Lay) => {
  if (!f || y + h / 2 < f.top || y - h / 2 > f.bottom) return y;
  const below = f.bottom + h / 2 + 30, above = f.top - h / 2 - 30;
  if (below + h / 2 < L.lower.y - 70) return below;
  if (above - h / 2 > L.safe.t) return above;
  // a close-up face fills the frame: the top of the safe area (over the hair) hides the least of it
  return L.safe.t + h / 2 + 10;
};

const UiItem: React.FC<{ u: UiP; t: number; cam: Cam; plan: Plan; bars: number; L: Lay; face: Face; dim: number }> = ({ u, t, cam, plan, bars, L, face, dim }) => {
  // the title / end card owns the screen while it shows: other overlays step back
  const a = span(t, u.t0, u.t1) * dim;
  if (a <= 0.001) return null;
  const x = u.ui;
  const lowY = L.lower.y - 40 * bars;
  switch (x.type) {
    case "title": return <Title a={a} text={x.text} sub={x.sub} kicker={x.kicker} y={L.portrait ? avoid(L.title.y, 180, face, L) : L.title.y} size={L.title.size} maxWidth={L.safe.r - L.safe.l} left={L.portrait ? L.safe.l : 0} right={L.portrait ? L.W - L.safe.r : 0} />;
    case "lower": return <Lower a={a} text={x.text} sub={x.sub} y={lowY + (L.portrait ? 0 : 40)} x={L.lower.x} size={L.lower.size} maxWidth={L.safe.r - L.safe.l} />;
    case "tag": { const [px, py0] = L.pos[x.pos ?? "tl"]; const py = L.portrait ? avoid(py0, 80, face, L) : py0; return <Tag x={px} y={py + (x.pos?.startsWith("t") ? 40 * bars : x.pos?.startsWith("b") ? -40 * bars : 0)} a={a} text={x.text} sub={x.sub} size={L.tag} anchor={x.pos?.endsWith("r") ? "r" : x.pos === "c" ? "c" : "l"} />; }
    case "callout": {
      const S = plan.scenes[u.scene];
      const moved = plan.objectsAt(t)[x.poi];
      const inst = plan.built?.insts.find((i) => i.id === x.poi);
      const w = moved && inst ? ([moved.pos[0], moved.pos[1] + inst.info.bounds[1] * 0.7 * inst.scale, moved.pos[2]] as [number, number, number]) : S.place.pois[x.poi] ?? (() => { const p = plan.poseOf(x.poi, t); return p ? ([p.x, p.y + 1.7, p.z] as [number, number, number]) : undefined; })();
      if (!w) return null;
      const p = project(cam, w, L.W, L.H);
      // keep the label inside the safe area: lead it towards the side with more room
      const left = p.x > (L.safe.l + L.safe.r) / 2 + (L.portrait ? 60 : 340);
      // the label (estimated width) stays inside the safe area: lead towards the side where it fits
      const lw = Math.max(x.text.length, (x.sub ?? "").length * 0.72) * L.tag * 0.66 + 48;
      const reach = L.portrait ? 110 : 170;
      const fitsR = p.x + reach + 8 + lw <= L.safe.r, fitsL = p.x - reach - 8 - lw >= L.safe.l;
      let dx = (left ? (fitsL || !fitsR ? -1 : 1) : (fitsR || !fitsL ? 1 : -1)) * reach;
      if (dx > 0 && p.x + dx + 8 + lw > L.safe.r) dx = Math.max(12, L.safe.r - lw - 8 - p.x);
      if (dx < 0 && p.x + dx - 8 - lw < L.safe.l) dx = -Math.max(12, p.x - L.safe.l - lw - 8);
      let dy = p.y < L.safe.t + 150 ? 90 : -90;
      if (p.y + dy < L.safe.t + 40) dy = L.safe.t + 40 - p.y;
      if (p.y + dy > L.lower.y - 90) dy = L.lower.y - 90 - p.y;
      return <Callout p={p} a={a} text={x.text} sub={x.sub} dx={dx} dy={dy} W={L.W} H={L.H} size={L.tag} />;
    }
    case "card": {
      const left = (x.pos ?? "l") === "l";
      const cx = L.portrait ? L.safe.l : left ? 120 : 1920 - 120 - L.card.w;
      return (
        <Card x={cx} y={L.portrait ? avoid(L.card.y + 40 + x.lines.length * 25, 80 + x.lines.length * 50, face, L) - 40 - x.lines.length * 25 : L.card.y} w={L.card.w} a={a}>
          {x.title ? <div style={{ fontSize: L.card.title, fontWeight: 600, color: CYAN, letterSpacing: "0.06em", marginBottom: 16 }}>{x.title}</div> : null}
          {x.lines.map((l, i) => (
            <div key={i} style={{ fontSize: L.card.line, lineHeight: 1.45, color: INK, opacity: ease((t - u.t0 - 0.35 - i * 0.45) / 0.4), display: "flex", gap: 14 }}>
              <span style={{ color: AMBER }}>•</span><span>{l}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </Card>
      );
    }
    case "stamp": return <Stamp x={L.stamp[0]} y={L.portrait ? avoid(L.stamp[1], 110, face, L) : L.stamp[1] + 40 * bars} a={a} text={x.text} size={L.portrait ? 72 : 64} />;
    case "clock": return <Clock a={a} text={x.text} sub={x.sub} y={L.portrait ? avoid(L.clock, 200, face, L) : L.clock} />;
    case "steps": {
      const k = ease((t - u.t0 - 0.3) / Math.max(0.5, (u.t1 - u.t0) * 0.6));
      return L.steps.vertical
        ? <Flow x={L.steps.x - L.steps.w / 2} y={L.steps.y} a={a} items={x.items} k={k * x.items.length} w={L.steps.w} vertical />
        : <Flow x={960 - (x.items.length * 330) / 2} y={540} a={a} items={x.items} k={k} />;
    }
  }
  return null;
};

/** word-timed caption line, current word lit (the brand accent when it reads, else warm yellow) */
const Captions: React.FC<{ plan: Plan; t: number; L: Lay; hide: number }> = ({ plan, t, L, hide }) => {
  const c = plan.captions.find((x) => t >= x.t0 - 0.04 && t < x.t1);
  if (!c || hide > 0.98) return null;
  const a = ease((t - c.t0 + 0.04) / 0.1) * (1 - ease((t - c.t1 + 0.12) / 0.12)) * (1 - hide);
  const hot = plan.brand?.accent && /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(plan.brand.accent) ? plan.brand.accent : "#ffd76a";
  // the line sits on its own dark plate: an outline alone vanishes on a bright or same-coloured background (a
  // yellow shirt under the lit yellow word)
  return (
    <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: (L.safe.l + L.safe.r) / 2 - L.cap.w / 2, width: L.cap.w, top: L.cap.y, transform: `translateY(-50%) scale(${0.96 + 0.04 * a})`, textAlign: "center", opacity: a, fontFamily: FONT, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: L.cap.size, lineHeight: 1.12, letterSpacing: "0.01em" }}>
      <span style={{ display: "inline", padding: `${L.cap.size * 0.1}px ${L.cap.size * 0.3}px`, borderRadius: L.cap.size * 0.26, background: "rgba(8,10,14,0.62)", boxDecorationBreak: "clone", WebkitBoxDecorationBreak: "clone" }}>
        {c.words.map((w, i) => {
          const on = t >= w.t0 - 0.02 && t < w.t1 + 0.05;
          return <span key={i} style={{ color: on ? hot : "#ffffff", paintOrder: "stroke fill", WebkitTextStroke: "6px rgba(0,0,0,0.85)", textShadow: "0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)" }}>{w.w}{i < c.words.length - 1 ? " " : ""}</span>;
        })}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
};

export const FilmOverlay: React.FC<{ plan: Plan; t: number; cam: Cam }> = ({ plan, t, cam }) => {
  const L = plan.format === "portrait" ? PORTRAIT : LANDSCAPE;
  const bars = plan.bars(t);
  const tc = plan.titleCard, dc = plan.disclaimer, ec = plan.endCard, br = plan.brand;
  const ta = tc ? span(t, tc.t0, tc.t1, 0.9, 0.8) : 0;
  const da = dc ? span(t, dc.t0, dc.t1, 0.6, 0.6) : 0;
  const ea = ease((t - ec.t0) / 1.2) * (1 - ease((t - (ec.t1 - 0.9)) / 0.9));
  // once the end card is up the story's overlays are done: they never come back while it fades out
  const eOn = ease((t - ec.t0) / 1.2);
  const ia = br?.intro ? span(t, br.intro.t0, br.intro.t1, 0.25, 0.35) : 0;
  const face = L.portrait ? faceOf(plan, t, cam, L) : null;
  const col: React.CSSProperties = L.portrait ? { position: "absolute", left: L.safe.l, right: L.W - L.safe.r, top: 0, bottom: 0 } : { position: "absolute", inset: 0 };
  return (
    <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, fontFamily: FONT }}>
      {L.portrait ? <PortraitShade /> : null}
      {plan.ui.map((u, i) => (t >= u.t0 - 0.1 && t <= u.t1 + 0.1 ? <UiItem key={i} u={u} t={t} cam={cam} plan={plan} bars={bars} L={L} face={face} dim={1 - Math.max(ta, eOn, ia)} /> : null))}
      {L.portrait ? null : <Letterbox k={bars} />}
      <Captions plan={plan} t={t} L={L} hide={Math.max(ta, eOn, ia)} />
      {br?.watermark && br.logo && eOn < 0.5 ? <Img src={staticFile(br.logo)} style={L.portrait ? { position: "absolute", right: L.W - L.safe.r, top: L.safe.b - 82, height: 72, opacity: 0.7 } : { position: "absolute", left: L.safe.l, top: L.safe.t + 30, height: 56, opacity: 0.7 }} /> : null}
      {ia > 0.001 && br ? (
        <div style={{ ...col, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", color: "#e9eef8", opacity: ia }}>
          {br.logo ? <Img src={staticFile(br.logo)} style={{ height: L.portrait ? 150 : 120, marginBottom: 26 }} /> : null}
          {br.name ? <div style={{ fontSize: L.portrait ? 44 : 38, fontWeight: 300, letterSpacing: "0.32em", paddingLeft: "0.32em", textAlign: "center" }}>{br.name}</div> : null}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {ta > 0.001 && tc ? (
        <div style={{ ...col, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", color: "#e9eef8", background: L.portrait ? undefined : `rgba(0,0,0,${0.35 * ta})` }}>
          {L.portrait ? <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: -L.safe.l, right: -(L.W - L.safe.r), top: 0, bottom: 0, background: `rgba(0,0,0,${0.35 * ta})` }} /> : null}
          {tc.kicker ? <div style={{ position: "relative", fontSize: L.portrait ? 26 : 22, fontWeight: 500, letterSpacing: "0.45em", opacity: ta * 0.75, marginBottom: 26, paddingLeft: "0.45em", textAlign: "center" }}>{tc.kicker}</div> : null}
          <div style={{ position: "relative", fontSize: L.portrait ? 76 : 74, fontWeight: 200, whiteSpace: L.portrait ? "normal" : "nowrap", textAlign: "center", lineHeight: 1.15, letterSpacing: `${(L.portrait ? 0.24 : 0.42) - 0.1 * ta}em`, paddingLeft: "0.2em", opacity: ta, textShadow: "0 0 40px rgba(120,150,220,0.35)" }}>{tc.text}</div>
          {tc.sub ? <><div style={{ position: "relative", width: 120 * ta, height: 1, background: "rgba(233,238,248,0.6)", margin: "30px 0 26px" }} /><div style={{ position: "relative", fontSize: L.portrait ? 34 : 30, fontWeight: 300, letterSpacing: "0.04em", opacity: ta * 0.85, textAlign: "center" }}>{tc.sub}</div></> : null}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {da > 0.001 && dc ? <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: L.safe.l, maxWidth: L.safe.r - L.safe.l, ...(L.portrait ? { top: L.safe.t + 10 } : { bottom: 70 + 84 * bars }), fontSize: L.portrait ? 26 : 24, fontWeight: 500, color: "#dfe6f2", opacity: da * 0.9, letterSpacing: "0.04em", textShadow: "0 2px 12px #000" }}>{dc.text}</div> : null}
      {ea > 0.001 ? (
        <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, background: `rgba(2,4,8,${0.85 * ea})` }}>
          <div style={{ ...col, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", color: "#e9eef8" }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: L.portrait ? 64 : 64, fontWeight: 200, letterSpacing: L.portrait ? "0.2em" : "0.3em", paddingLeft: "0.2em", opacity: ea, whiteSpace: L.portrait ? "normal" : "nowrap", textAlign: "center", lineHeight: 1.2 }}>{ec.text}</div>
            {ec.sub ? <div style={{ fontSize: L.portrait ? 32 : 28, fontWeight: 300, marginTop: 26, opacity: ea * 0.8, textAlign: "center" }}>{ec.sub}</div> : null}
            {br ? (
              <div style={{ marginTop: L.portrait ? 90 : 60, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "center", opacity: ease((t - ec.t0 - 0.5) / 0.8) * ea }}>
                {br.logo ? <Img src={staticFile(br.logo)} style={{ height: L.portrait ? 130 : 96, marginBottom: 22 }} /> : null}
                {br.name ? <div style={{ fontSize: L.portrait ? 40 : 34, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: "0.08em" }}>{br.name}</div> : null}
                {br.handle ? <div style={{ fontSize: L.portrait ? 32 : 28, fontWeight: 400, marginTop: 10, color: br.accent ?? CYAN }}>{br.handle}</div> : null}
                {br.cta ? <div style={{ fontSize: L.portrait ? 30 : 26, fontWeight: 400, marginTop: 18, opacity: 0.85, textAlign: "center", maxWidth: L.safe.r - L.safe.l }}>{br.cta}</div> : null}
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
};

==== 1015 project/src/film/project.ts
import { Vector3 } from "three";
import type { Cam } from "../cine/Post.tsx";
import type { V3 } from "../cine/Lights.tsx";

/** Project a world point to overlay pixels (W × H: 1080×1920 portrait, 1920×1080 landscape); z < 0 = behind. */
export const project = (cam: Cam, p: V3, W = 1920, H = 1080): { x: number; y: number; z: number } => {
  const pos = new Vector3(...cam.pos), f = new Vector3(...cam.target).sub(pos).normalize();
  const right = new Vector3().crossVectors(f, new Vector3(0, 1, 0)).normalize();
  let up = new Vector3().crossVectors(right, f).normalize();
  const r = cam.roll ?? 0;
  if (r) {
    const u2 = up.clone().multiplyScalar(Math.cos(r)).addScaledVector(right, Math.sin(r));
    right.crossVectors(f, u2).normalize();
    up = u2;
  }
  const d = new Vector3(...p).sub(pos);
  const z = d.dot(f), x = d.dot(right), y = d.dot(up);
  const th = Math.tan((cam.fov * Math.PI) / 360);
  return { x: W / 2 + (x / (z * th * (W / H))) * (W / 2), y: H / 2 - (y / (z * th)) * (H / 2), z };
};
